scope: Supervised bounded mainnet transport and WAL of delivered notifications; market candidates sampled. Connected transport is not proof of chain coverage. Recovery status is explicit provider-reported evidence.  No database pool is attached to this monitor; database responsiveness is separately validated. Current confirmed WebSocket receipts; strict finalized creation verification; current finalized accounts. Both actual buy and sell simulations required before an entry; mandatory-risk failures are durably rejected before simulation. No invented fill or risk overrides. Public RPC errors and unsupported variants are retained.
